What’s the maximum number of mobile lines I can have with Maxx?

Each customer can sign up for a maximum of 10 postpaid mobile lines. You can check how many SIMs you currently have here

If you have 9 or fewer SIMs, you can purchase additional SIMs. If you already own 10 or more SIMs, you will not be able to purchase new SIMs. To add a new line, you can either terminate an existing line or port in your existing number.

For non-Singapore passport holders, each customer can sign up for a maximum of 3 prepaid mobile lines.

If you have 2 or fewer SIMs, you can purchase additional SIMs. If you already own 3 SIMs, you will not be able to purchase new SIMs. To add a new line, you can terminate an existing line.

SIM Only Plans in Singapore: No-Contract 5G from $10

A SIM only plan lets you use your own phone and pay only for the service: data, calls and SMS, with no handset bundled in and no contract to sign. Maxx SIM only plans in Singapore start from $10 a month. You can choose an eSIM or a physical SIM, and most people finish signing up in under 2 minutes.

Maxx runs on the M1 network, and every plan comes with no lock-in, no excess charges, and no bill shocks, so the bill you expect is the bill you get.

Looking for the best SIM only plan in Singapore? The right one depends on how you use your phone. Light users can start with the $10 plan. If you stream a lot, work on the move or cross the causeway often, a higher-tier plan makes more sense. Compare the plans above and pick the one that fits.

Read more  

What Every Maxx SIM Plan Includes

  • Local data you can use in Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Hong Kong & Thailand
  • Roaming data in 100+ countries
  • eSIM or physical SIM
  • Unlimited voice roaming
  • Add-on data packs when you need extra

What the Higher-Tier Plans Add

  • Local data in more countries, including China and Japan (check the plan table for the full list)
  • More roaming data for APAC and international roaming

Which Maxx SIM Plan Suits You?

  • Light users: Mostly on Wi-Fi with a bit of data on the go. Start with the lowest-priced plan.
  • Heavy users: Streaming, video calls, hotspotting. Look at the higher tiers.
  • Frequent travellers: If you're regularly in Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines, India, China or Japan, pick a plan that covers those countries locally.

Why Choose a SIM Only Plan?

Because you pay for service, not for a phone. With a SIM only plan you keep the handset you already own, skip the extra monthly cost that comes with a bundled phone plan, and can leave whenever you like without early termination fees. Maxx adds clear pricing from day one, with no excess data charges and no surprise roaming fees.

SIM Only Plan FAQs

What are SIM only plans?

A SIM only plan gives you mobile data, calls and SMS on a SIM card or eSIM, without a phone included. You bring your own device and pay a lower monthly fee for the service alone. Maxx SIM plans in Singapore come with no contract and no excess charges. Check the plan table for the latest promotions.

How to purchase a Maxx SIM only plan?

Tap "Buy Now" on the plan you want. For a physical SIM, fill in your details, confirm your delivery address and pay, and the SIM will be sent to you. For an eSIM, choose "eSIM (Instant Activation)", add your details and pay. Make sure your phone supports eSIM first. The whole purchase takes under 2 minutes. Our FAQs page covers eSIM setup in more detail.

How to activate your new SIM card?

  1. Download the Maxx app and tap "Activate My SIM".
  2. Physical SIM: scan the barcode on your SIM card. eSIM: skip this step.
  3. Choose your new mobile number.
  4. Enter the activation code from your emailed receipt.
  5. Verify your identity with Singpass or by scanning your physical ID.
  6. Insert your SIM, or scan the eSIM QR code. You'll get an SMS once you're live.

How do I port in to Maxx?

You can keep your current number. Download the Maxx app and tap "Activate My SIM". For a physical SIM, scan its barcode first. Then enter the number to port in, your current telco and your subscription type. Your activation code is on the envelope (labelled MAXX-####-####) or in your delivery SMS or email. Enter it as ####-####, then verify with Singpass or your ID, which must match your registration on maxxonline.sg. The Subscriber ID for your Maxx plan and the number you're porting in must be the same. Porting takes up to 3 working days, and you'll be notified by SMS.

Do SIM only plans include international roaming?

It depends on the provider. Some include roaming data, others charge extra for it. Maxx plans come with roaming data in 100+ countries, and our 5G plans include unlimited voice roaming. If you need more data overseas, you can buy an add-on data pack.

How long is the contract for a SIM only plan?

Most SIM only plans have no long-term contract, and Maxx has none. You can stop whenever you want, with no early termination fee.

Is a SIM only plan cheaper than a traditional mobile plan in Singapore?

Often, yes, because you aren't paying off a handset in your monthly fee. The saving depends on what you'd compare it with, so look at data, roaming and add-on costs side by side, not just the monthly price. Maxx publishes its prices up front, so there's nothing to decode.

What is the difference between a SIM plan and a SIM only plan?

In everyday use, people often mean the same thing. A SIM only plan is a mobile plan where you supply your own phone and receive just a SIM or eSIM. A "SIM plan" is the casual way of saying it. Some people also use it for a plan that includes a phone, so check what's bundled before you sign.

Which network does Maxx use?

Maxx runs on the M1 network, so you connect through M1's mobile coverage in Singapore. You still sign up, pay and manage your plan with Maxx online and in the Maxx app.

Can I use an eSIM on a Maxx SIM plan?

Yes, if your phone supports eSIM. Choose "eSIM (Instant Activation)" at checkout and scan the QR code to activate.
